title: Range-fetch directly to a Matroska block inside a large Cluster

definition.title: Range-fetch directly to a Matroska block inside a large Cluster
definition.source_excerpt: Combine validated cue cluster/relative positions with required timestamp, track and codec context to fetch the seek target without an unrelated cluster prefix. Preserve source identity and dependency reads.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Locate one real repeated read/index/validation boundary and its trusted source identity. Separate logical requests from transferred or physical-disk bytes.
definition.minimum_probe: Replay a short owned range/seek trace on a tiny indexed fixture, including its first cold operation, with the same source and authorization. Reuse the existing reader.
definition.initial_screen: Locate one real repeated read/index/validation boundary and its trusted source identity. Separate logical requests from transferred or physical-disk bytes. Replay a short owned range/seek trace on a tiny indexed fixture, including its first cold operation, with the same source and authorization. Reuse the existing reader.
definition.primary_metric: Total bytes and time to correct startup/target, including cold index/identity acquisition; bounded retained bytes.
definition.scope_contract: Source/version identity, requested exact sample/frame, dependency coverage and byte-range accounting.
definition.negative_control: Change the source/version or corrupt an offset/proof and cancel one consumer. No stale or unverified bytes may be published.
definition.stop_boundary: Do not build a generic cache, transport server or index service for a first pass. Preserve a lower-cost component decision if real integration is E3.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Authorized seekable byte provider and a known oracle for sample prerequisites; no guessed remote-source semantics.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.

prepare.basis: Authored large Cluster with independently verified packets, timing and source-bound index; actual RangeReader and WebCodecs candidate.

screen.basis: Authored large Cluster with independently verified packets, timing and source-bound index; actual RangeReader and WebCodecs candidate.

correctness.basis: Truthful CueRelativePosition into one genuine 3.65 MB VP9 Cluster passed exact source packet/timeline preservation, 30 independent full host and Chrome decoded pictures, malformed offset, changed ETag, missing RAP and in-flight cancellation controls. Nine alternating cold HTTP/header/Cues/parse/copy/temp-IVF/decode/close pairs saved median82.36% time (95%81.87–82.62%) and93.73% wire bytes against bounded prefix scanning. Prebuilt index preparation and WAN are excluded; source index generation was independently checked, no native Matroska support claimed.
